integrity: The claim is a symbolic consequence of two independently checked average theorems on the same mirror-distinguishing ensemble. The knot-level density bound uses only nonnegativity, the standard genus bound 2g<=c-1, and an elementary expectation inequality. The bundled script checks arithmetic only.
scientific_limitations: The density bound is distribution-free and need not be sharp. The result uses only marginal average asymptotics and does not determine the limiting distribution of the orientability penalty or extend beyond the stated 2-bridge-knot ensemble.
title: Linear orientability penalty for spanning surfaces of 2-bridge knots
